# MinigameManager

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Minigames.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Minigames.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Runtime/Scripts/Minigames/MinigameManager.cs#L20)

The minigames module. Runs a training session split into parts, each a scene of its own with
its own clock: counts the time down, records whether the part was finished in time, and loads
the next part - or the part to fall back to when one is failed. Registers itself as
[`IMinigameService`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/IMinigameService).

Progress lives on the [`MinigameSet`](/api/vrframework-minigames-runtime/MinigameSet) asset rather than on this component, so
it survives the scene load between parts.

```csharp
public class MinigameManager : VRModule, IMinigameService
```

### NextPart() {#nextpart}

Closes the current part: records its outcome with the Mistakes module, then loads the next
part. On the final part nothing is loaded and session shutdown takes over.

```csharp
public void NextPart()
```
